resources.string: This connection runs through a relay, and the relay pass it was issued is about to run out. It will end shortly — finish what is in flight, then start a new session.
The relay pass was extended. The connection keeps going — nothing was re-paired and nothing was re-sent.
The relay pass could not be extended. The connection will end when the current one runs out.
The other device is running a version that cannot extend a relay pass. The connection will end when the current one runs out.
The relay pass this connection was issued ran out, so it ended. Nothing more can arrive on it — start a new session to continue.
